question: In how many of the five states shown does the male segment exceed the female segment? (A) 5 (B) 4 (C) 3. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health stacked_bar chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the largest stack. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: A (5). Bait: C (3).
